ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory statutory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against the Belize national AML/CFT framework, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU and UK consolidated financial-sanctions targets, and negative-media/reputational databases. Foreign and domestic PEPs (including family members and close associates) trigger enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Given the Medical_PPE_Consumables model and the designated payment rails (SWIFT documentary letters of credit and TT wire transfers), the registered agent will require a source-of-funds declaration, confirmation of the end-purchaser's medical-device licensing, and a sanctions compliance questionnaire from the beneficiary before onboarding. Banking_AML_Risk_Tier: Low_Risk_Standard.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) of Belize - official corporate registry and electronic name-clearance system located in Belize City; name reservations are submitted via the CCAR online portal or filed by a licensed Belize registered agent under the IBC Act (Chapter 270, Laws of Belize)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole official filing language. A proposed IBC name must be in Latin script; any non-English name (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) must be transliterated into Latin characters and accompanied by a certified English translation at the clearance stage. The registered name must end in 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Societe Anonyme' or an approved abbreviation (Ltd., Corp., Inc., S.A.).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The Registry's name clearance is valid for a 30-day reservation window from the date of approval. Any extension requires a written application to the Registrar (with the reservation/renewal fee) before expiry. Upon rejection - typically for identity or confusing similarity with an existing registered name - the applicant or its licensed registered agent may, within 14 days of the refusal, (1) file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar annexing the refusal notice, the fresh name-search report and a distinctive-mark submission; (2) where the conflict arises from an existing company's name, file that company's notarized written consent with a new clearance application; or (3) after exhausting administrative remedies, apply to the Supreme Court of Belize for judicial review on grounds of procedural irregularity. In practice the Registry permits immediate re-filing under a new distinctive token, avoiding judicial escalation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-office address is not independently acceptable as the statutory registered office. The IBC Act obliges every IBC to maintain a physical registered office in Belize at the premises of its licensed registered agent, where the statutory records and the Register of Beneficial Owners are kept. A virtual office may be used only as a non-statutory correspondence or marketing address outside Belize, provided the physical registered office remains in place.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated unannounced on-site inspection probability of under 10% per annum. Nitrile glove manufacturing is not a 'relevant activity' under the Economic Substance (Business in a Substantial Manner) Act, 2019, so no economic-substance physical-presence test applies to the Belize IBC. Inspection risk is consequently confined to Registry or Belize Financial Intelligence Unit verification of the registered agent's records, ordinary annual-renewal compliance, or targeted AML/CFT sweeps of the international financial services sector.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270, Revised Edition 2020), ss. 3-11 (incorporation), ss. 20-21 (memorandum and articles), s. 25 (registered office and registered agent); residual application of Companies Act (Cap. 250).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (dual instrument) filed on Form IBC 1, leading to the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; IBC permits a single member with nominal US$1 paid-up capital and no escrow or capital verification requirement. Authorized capital may be expressed with or without par value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopts the Share Subscription Agreement allotting 100,000 Management Shares at US$0.01 each to the founding subscriber, acknowledging receipt of US$1,000 as paid-up capital. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be situated at the offices of its licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize, as stated in the Memorandum of Association. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as officers of the Corporation: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until removed by the Board. RESOLVED, that the President and Secretary are jointly authorized to execute all statutory filings, open bank accounts, and pursue all industrial, environmental, and trade licensing applications required for the nitrile glove manufacturing facility.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) - Business Names Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the licensed registered agent, file a written name reservation request listing up to three ranked candidate names to confirm that the proposed company name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity and does not contain restricted words.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused on distinctiveness or prohibited-word grounds, resubmit with alternative names or appeal to the Registrar under IBC Act s. 36(4) within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, together with consents of the registered agent and registered office, to the Registry for statutory compliance review and registration.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed by subscriber)
Consent to act as registered agent
Consent to act as registered office
Certified identity documents of subscriber and intended directors
Registered agent certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon issuance of a correction notice, cure formal defects and resubmit within 14 days to avoid re-filing fees; further refusal may be appealed to the Registrar under s. 36.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) - Treasury Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the prescribed US$230 filing fee by wire transfer, bank draft, or registered agent account charge; the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation and certified charter documents upon confirmation of payment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not traced, provide wire confirmation and request re-verification; if the certificate contains clerical errors, apply for a corrected duplicate certificate under s. 11.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formalization of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (IBC service provider) and CCAR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered office agreement and registered agent acceptance letter, and ensure the statutory records (register of members, directors, and charges) are maintained at the registered office in Belize City.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office or agent changes after incorporation, file Form IBC 5 with the Registry within 30 days to avoid late-filing penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of First Board Resolution and Governance Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Business Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (written consent permitted), adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments; issue share certificates and open the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Board meeting minutes or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum is invalid, convene an adjourned board meeting and record corrected minutes; any defect in appointments is cured by subsequent board ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Manufacturing Trade License and Medical Device Establishment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Trade Licensing Board, Ministry of Economic Development (via BELTRAIDE One-Stop Shop) and the Medicines and Medical Devices Regulatory Agency, Ministry of Health and Wellness
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a manufacturing trade license application for the dipping plant, and a separate medical device establishment license application for sterile examination gloves classified as Class II medical devices; attach environmental approval and fire safety certificates.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution
Factory site lease or ownership documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If declined, appeal to the Minister of Economic Development within 30 days or resubmit an amended application addressing the specific licensing conditions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Trade Licensing Board (Ministry of Economic Development) jointly with the Medicines and Medical Devices Regulatory Agency (Ministry of Health and Wellness) for medical-grade sterile nitrile gloves
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Trade License under the Trade Licensing Act (Cap. 288) and Establishment Licence for Medical Devices under the Medicine and Medical Devices Act (Cap. 47)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment (DOE), Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report (Category 2 - Industrial Development) required before construction; post-approval Environmental Compliance Plan (ECP) mandatory for operation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent per EPA discharge criteria: BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, COD ≤ 150 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, pH 6-9; nitrile solvent and VOC emissions controlled via activated carbon scrubbers and thermal oxidizers; hazardous waste handling and manifesting per the Solid Waste Management and Hazardous Waste Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Belize National Fire Service under the Fire Services Act; structural load and building inspection by the Central Building Authority; occupational safety and health clearance per the Safety and Health at Work (OSH) Act, verified by the Department of Labour and the Belize Bureau of Standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (BTS), Ministry of Finance; e-Services and e-Filing Portal: https://eservices.belize.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Belize International Business Company (IBC) is incorporated through the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) under the International Business Companies Act, obtaining a Certificate of Incorporation and Company Number. The IBC is automatically tax-exempt in Belize and is not required to obtain a domestic Income Tax Identification Number for its exempt activities. If the IBC nevertheless makes taxable supplies in Belize or imports goods requiring customs clearance, it must apply to the Belize Tax Service for a General Sales Tax (GST) registration number using Form BTS-GST-01, accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office address, and a completed Taxpayer Information Form. A general TIN may also be issued for administrative purposes if the IBC becomes an employer of Belize-based staff or engages in any taxable activity. For foreign entities that are not IBCs, a TIN is obtained upon business registration with BTS and issuance of a Business Taxpayer Certificate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize does not operate a check-the-box regime. The IBC's tax-exempt status is automatic and mandatory under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270 (as amended). No hybrid mismatch election is available because the IBC is not subject to Belize income tax. An IBC may voluntarily elect to be treated as an ordinary domestic company only by converting its status under the Companies Act, a formal corporate restructuring outside the IBC tax exemption. A qualifying IBC may also elect to redomicile from Belize to another jurisdiction, but this does not alter its exempt classification while registered as an IBC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) - Belize 'Value Added Tax' equivalent
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 50,000 annual taxable turnover for goods and services supplied in Belize; no mandatory registration threshold for IBCs whose supplies are exclusively offshore and zero-rated, but registration may be required for imports or Belize-facing taxable supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize has no mandatory real-time electronic fiscal clearance, no API-connected continuous transaction control (CTC) system, and no digital stamping obligation. Taxpayers are required to issue serially numbered GST tax invoices, retain them for a minimum period in accordance with the General Sales Tax Act, and submit periodic GST returns through the Belize Tax Service e-filing portal. Standard original invoices and supporting customs export evidence must be produced on audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The export of nitrile examination gloves physically shipped from Belize to an overseas customer qualifies for zero-rated GST where the supply is sold for export, the goods are exported within a prescribed statutory time limit (customarily within 3 months), and the exporter retains documentary proof of export. Services supplied to a non-resident for use wholly outside Belize, including offshore trading and logistics services incidental to the export of medical consumables, may also qualify for zero-rating where the Belize supplier is not a registered IBC making local supplies. An IBC is inherently tax-exempt and generally not within the GST registration system; if it voluntarily registers for GST, it must strictly substantiate export zero-rating to recover input tax on purchases.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Belize Customs - entry form and export permit)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure of goods from Belize
Certified Certificate of Origin for medical devices (ISIC 3250)
Sales Contract or Purchase Order evidencing foreign buyer and payment terms
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Foreign Exchange Confirmation evidencing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Belize Tax Service may conduct audit scrutiny of any GST refund claimed or zero-rated export supply. Claims found to lack substantiation are disallowed, and the corresponding output GST is clawed back with a 100% penalty under the General Sales Tax Act, plus statutory interest from the original filing date. Negligent or fraudulent export zero-rating claims attract civil penalties of up to 300% of the tax evaded and criminal fines not exceeding BZD 10,000 per offence; directors, officers, and principals may be subject to imprisonment up to 3 years. Sham export schemes, non-return of goods, or round-tripping of the identical gloves or packaging will be recharacterised as domestic taxable supplies, and all exemptions are retrospectively revoked for up to 6 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB) — the monetary authority and prudential regulator of all licensed banks, credit unions and financial intermediaries in Belize, responsible for currency issuance, the exchange-rate regime, and operation of the national payment and clearing systems under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Cap. 262).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar (BZD) is pegged to the US dollar at a fixed rate of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 with a narrow fluctuation band and is freely convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions performed by non-residents. Belize abolished its exchange-control machinery in 2001; no prior CBB approval is required for inbound foreign direct investment, foreign-currency account maintenance, or outward profit, dividend and capital remittances by non-resident entities. A Belize International Business Company (IBC) is structurally non-resident and, pursuant to section 6 of the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), is exempt from all Belize exchange-control requirements, taxes, stamp duties, withholding taxes and foreign-currency surrender obligations for 50 years. The only operational convertibility friction is documentary: Belize licensed banks require complete beneficial-ownership and source-of-funds records before releasing USD onward payments, but no statutory convertibility or profit-repatriation hurdle exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Belize does not impose any statutory timeline, minimum percentage, or CBB-directed requirement for the surrender, repatriation, or compulsory conversion of export proceeds. A BZ IBC deriving revenue from the sale of sterile examination nitrile gloves (ISIC 3250 / NAICS 339113) may retain 100% of all export earnings in USD or other convertible currencies, maintain proceeds in offshore or onshore Belize foreign-currency accounts, and deploy funds freely for trade settlement and investment without reporting to the CBB. This position is consistent with Belize's obligations under IMF Article VIII.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low / not viable as the principal treasury rail. Belize has no Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing category and no statutory passporting mechanism for foreign EMIs; only deposit-taking banks licensed under the Banking and Financial Institutions Act (Cap. 261) and offshore banks licensed under the Offshore Banking Act may lawfully hold client funds or issue payment instruments within Belize. An offshore fintech EMI domiciled in the UK, EU, or Singapore may be deployed strictly as an ancillary collections account for small distributor receipts in USD/EUR/GBP, but it cannot replace a licensed correspondent bank for Commercial Letter of Credit issuance, cannot act as an issuing/advising bank under UCP600, and introduces independent UBO-disclosure and sanctions-screening frictions that materially impair the audit trail required for a regulated medical-device enterprise.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permissible under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act (Cap. 103) as amended by the AML/CFT (Amendment) Act 2022; no statutory requirement mandates physical appearance of directors or UBOs in Belize. Licensed Belize banks routinely accept remote videoconference KYC for IBC accounts provided that: (i) notarized/apostilled certified copies of passports, proof of address and a source-of-wealth questionnaire are submitted; (ii) the licensed Registered Agent / corporate services provider in Belize furnishes an incumbency certificate, good-standing certificate and professional introducer opinion; and (iii) the bank's compliance officer completes an interactive video interview with each signatory UBO. For trade-finance or documentary LC facilities, an additional in-person or high-assurance video interview is standard practice before the facility is approved. A consular appointment abroad is not mandatory where an approved introducing bank or licensed CSP attests to identity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IBC structural opacity — nominee directors, bearer shares or untraceable beneficial ownership flagged at customer acceptance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the FIU-compliant beneficial-ownership register, the full corporate ladder back to each natural-person UBO, nominee declaration and indemnity agreements, Certificate of Incumbency and Certificate of Good Standing from the Belize Companies Registry, and a professional opinion letter from the licensed Registered Agent. Best practice: eliminate all nominee layers and register shares directly in the UBOs' names prior to bank account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sectoral red flag — bulk medical PPE contracts with sovereign buyers, PAHO/UN procurement agencies or government health ministries screened for fraud, over-invoicing or diversion of consignments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed supply and purchase agreements, end-user and non-diversion certificates, product regulatory approvals (FDA 510(k), EU MDR/CE certificate, ISO 13485 and ISO 10993), manufacturing plant certificates, complete shipment records (B/L, packing list, export health certificates), and a period-over-period reconciliation file linking invoices with corresponding SWIFT MT103 and LC drawdowns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Purpose mismatch — newly formed tax-exempt IBC receiving a significant inbound capital injection without a credible commercial or industrial explanation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a treasury and project memorandum for the high-speed dipping production line, pro-forma equipment invoices from the Asian or EU machinery supplier, a board resolution authorising the equity injection, audited or management financials of the funding shareholder, three months of source-bank statements evidencing lawful wealth accumulation, and a notarized Source-of-Wealth affidavit tied to capital-account purposes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank concern — Belize's historical CFATF deficiencies and prior inclusion on AML monitoring lists triggering escalated due diligence or refusal of USD clearing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present the banking licence, FIU Belize AML compliance certificate, sanctions and PEP screening results for all UBOs and counterparties, a written AML/CFT risk self-assessment, the IBC's corporate compliance calendar, and evidence of ongoing FIU record filings, thereby demonstrating remediation consistent with current CFATF mutual-evaluation follow-up. Optionally, pre-fund the first transaction or adopt enhanced periodic reporting to de-risk the relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Prohibited onshore nexus — IBC transacting with Belize-resident persons, owning Belize real estate, or otherwise breaching section 6 of the IBC Act, which would void the tax-exempt status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a Section 6 compliance statement, registered office and Registered Agent particulars, director and UBO residency certificates, confirmation of absence of any Belize real-property interest or leasehold, and a transaction-flow diagram proving that all manufacturing, invoicing, warehousing, insurance and treasury operations are conducted outside the domestic Belize economy or strictly with Belize-licensed international banks.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route share capital via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for bank-to-bank cover) from the UBO's own bank account directly to the IBC's USD account at the licensed Belize bank, passing through the Belize bank's USA correspondent (typically a New York money-center bank). Wire field 50K must name the true originator, field 59 must name the BZ IBC beneficiary, and the narrative must state: 'Equity contribution to BZ IBC — nitrile glove dip-plant CAPEX, ISIC 3250'. Use IMF BPM6 purpose code 'Equity and Investment Fund Shares — Direct Investment (E510)' where regulatory reporting applies, and attach the subscribed-capital schedule to the payment instruction. Where the injection exceeds authorized capital, file the board resolution increasing authorized capital first and document the excess as a shareholder loan with a written facility agreement to avoid recharacterization by the bank's AML unit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for recurring supplier payments (nitrile latex compound, calcium nitrate coagulant, packaging lines) within 48 hours of loading, and irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letters of Credit governed by UCP600 for major capex tranches; the Belize bank issues or advises the LC, the Asian or EU beneficiary receives settlement via MT700/MT798, cover is transmitted by MT202/MT202COV, and reimbursing banks settle using MT740/MT742 as applicable. Every drawdown must be matched against documentary evidence (commercial invoice, full-set ocean/air waybill, packing list, certificate of origin, and medical-device export licence) to satisfy AML expectations. Because the IBC may not transact with Belize-resident persons, all domestic regulatory fees (registered agent, annual business tax, government filing fees) must be discharged by the Registered Agent from its separate domestic account and settled through an intercompany reimbursement to the agent — never paid directly by the IBC to Belize domestic payees.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BZD onshore spot transactions and short-tenor (up to 6 months) USD/BZD FX forward contracts booked with the licensed Belize bank to hedge BZD working-capital needs at the pegged rate
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on BZD executed through an international FX counterparty, deployed only to hedge capital repatriation in a de-pegging contingency scenario

USD/EUR, USD/GBP and USD/CNH cross-currency swaps with an investment-grade non-Belize counterparty to hedge procurement and distributor-currency mismatches between Asian equipment suppliers and EU medical-device buyers
Multi-currency current accounts and natural hedging through matched receivable/payable currencies in USD and EUR to minimise forced FX conversion costs and correspondent-bank friction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Renewal (Renewal of International Business Company Registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Business Companies, Ministry of Finance, Belize City, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; payment accepted without penalty within 90 days following that anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment after the 90-day grace period incurs a 10% penalty; continued non-payment for 6 additional months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold applies to a Belize IBC. Independent audit becomes mandatory only if the IBC holds a regulated financial license under Belize financial services legislation, or if directors, members, or a lender require audited accounts under the entity's constitutional documents.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No local statutory accounting framework is imposed on IBCs; IFRS, US GAAP, or a consistent cash-basis accounting policy may be adopted. IFRS is recommended if a voluntary external audit is performed.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Belize maintains no public UBO register and does not require an annual UBO filing to the Registry. The registered agent must, however, perform an annual customer due diligence refresh, and shareholders/beneficial owners must notify the registered agent in writing of any ownership changes within 30 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Business Company (IBC) under section 6 of the Belize International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270; Belize's general corporate income tax rate for resident companies is 25%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Belize income tax, business tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty and withholding taxes on distributions; no minimum capital requirement; unrestricted non-resident ownership; IBC exemption is indefinite while the company remains compliant with the IBC Act.
